messages:
jules: noticing elevated OCSP stapling errors and occasional mTLS client rejects for services in apac-east this morning (around 10:12 local). backend logs show KMS IAM errors during cert refresh. anyone touching keyring perms?
samir: was looking at key policy tidyups last night. I removed a legacy binding to `projects/redwood/locations/apac/keyRings/ingress-keys/cryptoKeys/provision` for cluster SA `cert-manager@apac`. thought it was unused.
irina: that binding removal rings a bell. we did a scoped RBAC sweep to remove broad iamroles from cluster SAs. but KMS key IAM is separate from kube RBAC. did you update the key IAM?
samir: I patched a cloud-iam role to remove `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from a group. maybe that implicitly removed service account access. I can check the key IAM policy.
ops-bot: automated alert: 2026-03-23T10:11:42Z ocsp-staple-fail apac-east x5c-mismatch rate=0.9 -> Pager triggered.
jules: stack trace from cert-rotator: 
```
2026-03-23T10:12:15Z rotator ERROR: unwrap failed: calling KMS: PermissionDenied: requestor: serviceAccount:cert-manager@apac -> iam:denied\tat kms/client.go:142
```
samir: ok I see the key policy diff in my recent PR: removed group-binding `eng-ops-legacy@redwood` which included that SA transitively. I will re-add targeted binding for `serviceAccount:cert-manager@apac` with role `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypter`.
irina: before you do that, can we confirm no privilege creep? sec-bot: recommended minimal policy: only add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to the specific SA, with condition `request.time < timestamp("2027-03-23T00:00:00Z")` and resource restriction to the specific key.
ops-bot: runbook checklist suggestion: 1) regrant decrypt on ingress key to cert SA, 2) resume cert-rotator job, 3) verify OCSP stapling and mTLS handshakes for 30m, 4) run audit query for any RBAC/Key changes in last 24h.
samir: applying patch now: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding provision --location=apac-east --keyring=ingress-keys --member=serviceAccount:cert-manager@apac --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
ops-bot: policy-binding applied at 10:18:03Z (job id=kb-7781).
jules: cert-rotator shows rewrap at 10:20 and new certs issued. sample log: `rotator INFO: rewrapped key and signed cert svc=media-apac serial=0x9c7b`
irina: can we add a guard so RBAC sweeps that touch iam roles must run `kms-impact-check` job which queries dependent SAs and a test harness that attempts a test decrypt?
samir: agree. i'll add pre-submit check in infra-ci to simulate `gcloud kms decrypt` using a sandbox key and the affected SA via iam:simulate.
sec-bot: also recommend audit logging tweak: add a sink for `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.permissions` changes and tie alerts to any removal of `cryptoKeyDecrypter` from groups owning infra SAs.
jules: one more observation: some edge proxies flagged `tls: ocsp responder timeout` while the key was denied. seems cert-rotator retries caused backend latency increases. please note for SLO postmortem.
ops-bot: created ticket SEC-2026-309 documenting incident, policy diff, timeline, and remedial actions: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-309
samir: PR ready with targeted binding + infra-ci check. assigning to irina for review.
irina: will review, but require the `kms-impact-check` to block merge until green and request a short canary for apac-east only.
jules: thanks team, closing thread once PR merges and canary passes. :white_check_mark:
